text:
maria: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate SOC2 audit-log guidance and add an audit_schema v2 migration guide + fresh examples. Need short SDK snippets (Go/Node/Python), export JSON examples, and the legal-retention wording before the release cutoff.

sanjay: Can you paste the v2 diff?

maria: internal link: https://internal.redwood/audit/schema/v2-diff. Key changes: event_type -> audit_event.category, added service.context, normalized timestamps to iso8601, and retention hints in metadata.

alex: I can do Go and Node snippets. Any required fields for the JSON export sample?

maria: include audit_event.category, service.context.name, and request.kv_cache_id. Also show an example of a legal hold flag in metadata.

jen: Legal prefers this retention line: "Retention is configurable per customer account; the default retention period is 90 days. Exported audit records may be retained when required by law or legal process." Replace any instance of "customer" with "customer account".

alex: Draft Go snippet (will tidy):
```go
// list audit events with retention hint
res, err := client.Audit.List(ctx, AuditListParams{From: fromISO, To: toISO, RetentionHint: "90d"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Printf("found %d events\n", len(res.Items))
```

alex: Draft Node snippet:
```js
// node: query audit with retention hint
const res = await client.audit.list({ from: isoFrom, to: isoTo, retentionHint: '90d' })
console.log(`${res.items.length} events`)
```

sanjay: I'll add Python snippet and a small migration mapping table: old_field -> new_field. Also adding a curl export example showing the new JSON layout and legal_hold bit.

sanjay: Python snippet draft:
```py
# python: audit export with retention hint
res = client.audit.list(from=iso_from, to=iso_to, retention_hint='90d')
print(len(res['items']))
```

docs-bot: PR #4909 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4909 :rocket:

maria: We should also add a redirect from /docs/audit-log to /docs/audit/schema-v2/export to prevent old links breaking in the field. Who can add the redirect?

alex: I can add the redirect in the PR, small netlify/_redirects entry.

jen: One more legal check: don't use ambiguous terms like "may be retained" without context. The phrasing above is OK because it ties to legal process. After you change "customer" -> "customer account" I can approve.

sanjay: For the migration table I'll include a quick note about seq/kv cache IDs: "If seq/kv_cache_id is missing, map previous sequence_id to service.context.kv_cache_id."

maria: Also QA wants a tiny example showing how to run the export and validate fields locally (jq filter). Alex, can you include a sample jq in the JSON block?

alex: Adding this jq example to the export section: `jq '.items[] | {ts: .timestamp, category: .audit_event.category, svc: .service.context.name}' export.json`

sre: Heads-up from infra: export format change will require a minor bump to the export agent; we'll coordinate release windows. Please add a changelog note.

maria: Good call. I'll add a changelog entry and tag infra release owners.

jen: I'll do a final legal sweep tonight. If all good, merge after QA signoff.

maria: Thanks team. Plan: ship docs PR + redirect + snippets. Tagging @sre for the infra coord and @docs for review. :thumbsup:
